params.1273: Practice your non-combat spells and display your pizazz.
params.1292: Gives Pizazz Points which can be exchanged for armour, runes and spells.
params.1274: You may train as much as you wish in the arena.
params.1275: Talk to the staff at the arena to learn more.
params.1276: You will need to bring your own runes for enchanting, alchemy and telegrab spells.
params.1277: While you may enter the Arena at level 7 Magic, some spells require up to level 33 Magic.
